reference.electrical_header: VIN = VOUT + VDO, COUT = 10 uF, CIN = 0.1 uF, IL = 0; min/max at -40..125 C, typical at 25 C. VIN = VEN = 12 V belongs to typical curves, not the initial-accuracy header.
reference.shutdown_output: High-impedance shutdown described; no maximum powered-off/reverse output leakage or guaranteed discharge time established.
reference.EN: Low <= 0.5 V, high >= 1.6 V; avoid dwelling between. Tying EN to IN is allowed when unused; does not replace slew/startup verification.
reference.slew: Manufacturer recommends rise/fall near 6 V/ms to avoid stated startup/shutdown anomalies; no tolerance window or arbitrary-fault guarantee inferred.
reference.capacitance_applicability: Proposed 0.1..0.264 uF effective capacitance differs from the 10 uF electrical table condition; startup and transient applicability remain open.

comparator.input_clamp: Supply-rail diode clamps; beyond rail by 0.5 V requires current limit <= 10 mA absolute. Not an Ioff or functional powered-off guarantee.
comparator.bias: 5 nA maximum over temperature at VCM = VCC/2 in 2.7 V/5 V tables; proposed reference common-mode applicability held.
comparator.capacitance: 2 pF common-mode / 4 pF differential typical; 10 pF is an allocated total, not a manufacturer maximum.
comparator.propagation_and_hysteresis: ACT-07 applicability and maximum-hysteresis gates remain open.
comparator.below_minimum_supply: Below 2.7 V behavior is unspecified; the off description in section 7.4 is not an Ioff or retained-low guarantee.
comparator.differential_input: Section 8.1.1 warns against differential voltage greater than supply; current limiting alone does not qualify the application.

translator.boundary: TXU0102 zero-supply Ioff and <100 mV isolation conditions do not establish behavior throughout brownout.
